_about: One generated keyframe per cinematic shot (Resources/Cinematics/Art/<file>.jpg, 1280x720). make_reels.py wires them into the reels (back = file, cast = who is in it). Shots with cast are painted with Hawkes Gen image.paint on one front view per character (`front`: the sheet's first view cropped out and uploaded; at most two), because a whole four-view sheet as reference gets copied into the shot as duplicate characters, so each character stays on-model; shots without cast are image.generate. The full prompt is scene + place + style (+ the cast clause). Look source: Assets/Resources/UI/MenuArt.png (the sheets were made from it with image.edit).
style: Stylized 3D animated-film render, deep blue shadows with warm gold accents, soft lantern light and low mist, cinematic 16:9 composition. No sparks, glitter, embers, fireflies or floating light specks. No watermark, no captions.
castClause: Keep every character exactly as in their reference picture: the same design, colours and proportions. Each named character appears exactly once in the scene, at one size, in one pose: no second copy, no floating head or face, no inset portrait. The characters named here are the only characters in the picture: no crowd, no lookalikes.
negative: character sheet, turnaround, multiple views, duplicate character, crowd of identical characters, two of the same character, second copy, floating head, giant face in the sky, inset portrait, plain grey background, fireflies, sparks, glitter, embers, floating light specks, text, watermark, captions

places.hollow: the Moonlit Hollow at night: a grassy hollow ringed by trees and old iron lanterns, nine standing stones around a pale gold circle of light on the grass
places.edge: the edge of the Moonlit Hollow at night: the last lantern, a chalk road running into blue dark, far off a thin blank gate
places.floor: the Clearing Floor at night: a sunken yard lit amber by hanging lamps, rows of hooks holding identical small black robot shells, a long conveyor belt, one red signal lamp
places.walk: the Long Walk at dusk: a pale stone slab causeway over a pit of mist, paired tall lamp stilts like folded spider legs
places.reading: the Reading Room: a bare round hall lit lamp-gold, a circle drawn on the floor, the walls lined with rows of identical paper forms
places.filed: the Moonlit Hollow at blue dawn with no moon: the Department's wall reduced to a row of broken stumps, a pale slab path leading to a white doorframe on a dais, the circle glowing on the grass
places.dawn: the filed circle at dawn: the Moonlit Hollow under a warm gold-blue sunrise sky with no moon, the circle glowing gold on the grass
